name: Entity Reference Field Hints
description: Shows editor-facing helper text below supported entity reference field widgets listing the allowed target bundles and the bundles the current editor may create.
project_description: Entity Reference Field Hints adds editor-facing helper text beneath supported entity reference widgets so content authors can see which bundles are valid targets and which of those they are allowed to create. It works purely through Drupal's field widget hooks and third-party widget settings, so it enhances the standard entity reference widgets (autocomplete, select, radios, checkboxes) without replacing them or changing selection behavior. Support is scoped to entity_reference and entity_reference_revisions fields whose target type is media, node, paragraph, taxonomy_term, or user. Site builders enable and tune the hints per widget on each bundle's Manage form display page; no site-wide settings form, routes, or permissions are added. The 'Allowed' line lists the field's configured target bundles (or a configurable fallback string when all bundles are allowed), and the optional 'You can create' line lists only the allowed bundles the current user has entity create access to.
